race.comment: SLIPSAIN (11) has been knocking on the door for a little while now and doesn't have to improve much to finally land the winning blow. Gets in well with Williams' claim, who's in red-hot touch. Ready. FLAXLANDS (12) is a consistent mare and reunites with Maloney, who got the job done aboard three back. Yet to tackle this trip but is an obvious threat. ZAHER (4) has run himself into form and backs up quickly. Trip suits and the 3kg claim gets him in well. Don't underestimate. ALWAYS A RAINBOW (13) savaged the line fresh and then scored stylishly last time at Tamworth. Progressive mare that can raise the bar again.
